svg.text: CORNER MEETER-PAIR CATALOGUE: the two meeters of a doubly-met corner box, by TYPE and tilt SENSE
type: floor = touches the floor; wall = touches the wall; N / E / NE / IN = floater (touches no wall) with its centre above / right of / beyond / inside the box's far corner (1,1).

sense: 0 flat, + counter-clockwise, - clockwise (magnitude 2-43 deg, sampled: the catalogue ignores it). Cell = one feasible exemplar (exact checks), grey stipple = none in 4000 samples, red hatch = excluded by a lemma, dot = a meeter contains (1,1).
IS: a catalogue of corner meeter PAIRS at the BL corner (walls x = 0 and y = 0; the corner box dashed red). Each drawn cell passed: both squares meet the open box (area > 1e-4),

interiors disjoint, inside the quadrant, A / B touching as typed, floater centres in the named quadrant. Feasible cells 7, none-found 152, lemma-excluded 18, exemplars where a meeter contains (1,1): 4.
Lab names: floor+wall = PAIR (A259/A260 room); floor+floater = JAM (A262, C floats), wall+floater = its mirror; floater+floater = FLOAT2 (A277-A279); any pair with a THIRD meeter = THIRD.
Lemmas that prune the table: SAME-WALL (two touchers of one wall cannot both meet the box); WEDGED-SEAL (a meeter touching both walls is alone); a flush corner square is simple (k >= 1);
a meeter containing (1,1) meets all three corner cells. What the catalogue does NOT stratify: tilt magnitude, the second-layer squares (X, Y, holders), and the wall slots -- those enter per type.
